---
title: "Quarto Live template"
subtitle: "R in the browser via webR"
format: live-revealjs
engine: knitr

# Packages installed into webR when the deck loads (from repo.r-wasm.org).
webr:
  packages:
    - ggplot2
  cell-options:
    canvas: false   # draw plots with png() instead of an HTML canvas
    fig-width: 8
    fig-height: 3.5

# Files copied into webR's virtual filesystem. The leading ../ is dropped,
# so inside webR these live at data/..., the same paths the R scripts use.
resources:
  - ../data/abundance.tree.and.controls.txt
---

{{< include ../_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

## Setup {.smaller}

Hidden setup cell: `edit: false` cells run automatically once webR is ready.

```{webr}
#| edit: false
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))
```

Cells below are editable: `autorun: true` runs them on load, then **Run Code** or `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter` reruns after you edit.

## Read data

```{webr}
#| autorun: true
dat <- read.delim("data/abundance.tree.and.controls.txt")
str(dat)
```

## Plot

```{webr}
#| autorun: true
ggplot(dat, aes(DistReef, Abundance, colour = Treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 3)
```

## Static R (rendered ahead of time)

Plain `{r}` chunks run in the devcontainer's R at render time, not in the browser.
Use them for anything slow or not available in webR.

```{r}
#| echo: true
R.version.string
```
